Name: Morris of Jojo Mart by asdasdgfrw (updated for SVE by zwei7)
Author: zwei7
Description:
[u][size=3]Requirements[/size][/u]
[size=2]Stardew 1.5.4
Stardew Valley Expanded Mod 1.12.18 (SVE) or higher

[u][size=3]If you don't have the Stardew Valley Expanded Mod[/size][/u]
Get the Original Jojo Mod on [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/portrait-jojo-mart.108166/]Chucklefish Forums[/url]
[/size]
[u]History[/u]
The original portrait mod by [b]asdasdgfrw[/b] had 4 Morris faces in 2016 styled to look like Jojo's Bizarre Adventures style on [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/portrait-jojo-mart.108166/]Chucklefish Forums[/url]
However it only worked for vanilla Stardew Valley....
If you use SVE, it included portraits made by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/2679113-poltergeister/]Poltergeister[/url] which had 10 Morris faces made to look like Vanilla Stardew....
So I needed a mod that had 10 Morris faces + Jojo's Bizarre Adventures + SVE compatible

[u][size=3]About[/size][/u]
I merged [b]asdasdgfrw's[/b] and [b]Poltergeister's[/b] portraits to work with SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) with 10 faces 2021 in the style of Jojo's Bizarre Adventures.

[size=3][u]Installation instructions for Stardew Valley Expanded[/u][/size]
Place the [b]Morris.png[/b] into
Stardew Valley\Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\Portraits\Morris
It should replace the original SVE [b]Morris.png[/b] file
